confidence_notes: Overall low. Coffee and meal anchors rest on crowdsourced Expatistan averages, a Numbeo-derived national figure, and a chain price rise. The beer anchor is adjusted down from a dated GoEuro bar-beer average, which covers hotel bars and imported beer. The cocktail anchor blends a crowdsourced club average with an older bar listing. No direct per-glass wine price was found, so wine_glass is set at about 1.8x the beer anchor. The mid-range meal is an estimate for three courses without drinks, since the only dinner-for-two figure found included wine. All four hotel and hostel anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and were not checked against live listings or booking pages. NIS-to-USD conversions use about 3.05 NIS per USD, implied by conversions in the sources. The FX observation of 0.6947 for 2026-10-16 was taken from search-result text describing the RBA exchange-rate page, not from opening the page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Restaurant and drink anchors are anchored to Tel Aviv-specific sources (Expatistan crowdsourced averages, a Numbeo-derived Israel average, Aroma chain pricing, a GoEuro beer index cited by Tablet Magazine, and bar listings). Accommodation anchors are holistic model judgment reflecting Tel Aviv's high coastal hotel pricing in summer, without a comparable-city calibration.
